probe.text_sample: Your Page Title RSVP Info Gallery People Events Go home Northbound FAQ Wishlist Journal Overview Buy Menu RSVP Info Gallery People Events FAQ Wishlist Journal Overview Buy Groom Carlo Venturelli Tech enthusiast, amateur cook, and always making everyone laugh. Carlo will be the first to admit he’s not the most graceful person, but sometimes clumsiness leads to the best things in life. That morning in March 2019, he was juggling coffee for his entire team when he literally ran into the most beautiful woman he’d ever seen. What should have been mortifying became magical when Ylvie laughed at his joke instead of being angry about her ruined portfolio. As a renewable energy engineer, Carlo spends his days thinking about sustainability and efficiency, but Ylvie taught him about spontaneity and creativity. She encouraged him to pursue his side passion for cooking, cheered him on during his weekend rock climbing adventures, and somehow made him feel like the funniest person alive even when his jokes were absolutely terrible. The proposal wasn’t planned – they were sitting by the campfire after a challenging hike, Ylvie was sketching in her notebook, and Carlo just knew this was his person
